limitations: Presentation curves only; independent verification must certify the actual delivered polylines before packaging.
The curve budget is additional to the accepted 2500m simplified display. It is not a geographic survey accuracy claim.
Two-point straight arcs and fixed junctions remain straight; narrow contacts can require smaller local fillets.

policy.coordinateDerivation: New samples on local quadratic Bezier arcs in Mercator, inverse-projected once offline; all fixed junction coordinates retain exact baseline JSON numbers.
policy.displayUse: single curved internal-boundary representation at every zoom
policy.method: Quadratic Bezier fillets on accepted simplified interior corners; no extrapolation or waviness on straight segments.
